caption: The drawing features three primary objects located near the center of an off-white or beige background. At the top, there is a symmetrical, ornate object that appears to have two mirrored, flower-like or spiked motifs at each end, joined in the middle by a rectangular element, all rendered in shades of gray with fine linework. Below this, to the left, is a side view of a similar or the same object, showing a triangular profile with a decorated surface and pronounced protrusions, with a small rectangular loop extending from one side. To the right of this is a narrow, elongated object resembling a pin or stylus, depicted horizontally, with a hooked end and ornamentation along its length. Beneath these objects, centered, are the characters "A 3580 – 963" and to the right of this the text "LYMAN YOUNG." The overall composition is balanced, with ample space around the illustrated objects and the text. The drawing is executed in black and gray tones with clear and detailed lines.
title: Belt Buckle
